title: 第1章：命运的齿轮
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
（脑子寄存处……）

    …

    …

    2025年7月。

    夏日炎炎。

    江城的某处胡同拐角处。

    “快让让，快让让……”

    “啊！”

    惨叫声，电动车倒地声，打破了这宁静的早晨。

    紧接着就看见一个单马尾少女，惊慌失措的从地上爬起，而不远处，地上还躺着一名少年。

    “对不起，对不起小弟弟，我不是故意的。”

    “你有没有事，还能不能站起来？”

    “妈呀，怎么有血渍……”

    少女嘴唇哆嗦着，惊恐的瞪大双眼，白嫩细腻的脸颊上全是慌张，看不见半点血色，她是怎么也想不到，第一次骑电瓶车上路就发生了撞人事件。

    看对方瘦的浑身没几两肉，好似一阵风就能吹倒的消瘦身体，少女脸颊又白了一分。

    “该不会撞死人了吧？”

    “我，我摊上大事了！”

    少女呆愣在原地，完全一副被吓傻了的模样。

    而就在这时。

    少年缓缓睁开眼。

    准确的说，是这个叫马超的少年，刚从看见高楼大厦和川流不息的人群，以及马路上密集的车流的震惊中回过神。

    他就被电动车撞倒在地。

    “这就是天堂吗？可为什么会觉得痛呢？”

    “小弟弟，你没事吧？”

    “你是仙女姐姐。”

    “嗯？”

    “你在叫我？”
content_en:
(Brain storage place...)

    …

    …

    July 2025.

    Summer is hot.

    At the corner of an alley somewhere in Jiangcheng.

    "Quickly give up, quicky give up..."

    "Ah!"

    Screams and the sound of an electric car falling to the ground broke the peaceful morning.

    Then he saw a girl with a single ponytail getting up from the ground in panic, and not far away, there was a young man lying on the ground.

    "I'm sorry, I'm sorry little brother, I didn't mean it."

    "Are you okay? Can you still stand up?"

    "Oh my god, why are there blood stains..."

    The girl's lips were trembling, her eyes were wide open in fear, her white and delicate cheeks were full of panic, and there was no trace of blood. She never expected that she would be hit by someone on the road for the first time while riding a battery scooter.

    Seeing that the other party was so skinny that there was not much flesh on his body, as if his body could be blown over by a gust of wind, the girl's cheeks turned pale again.

    "Isn't it possible that someone was hit and killed?"

    "I, I'm in big trouble!"

    The girl froze on the spot, looking completely frightened.

    And just then.

    The young man slowly opened his eyes.

    To be precise, it was this young man named Ma Chao who had just recovered from the shock of seeing high-rise buildings, endless crowds of people, and dense traffic on the road.

    He was knocked to the ground by an electric car.

    "Is this heaven? But why do you feel pain?"

    "Little brother, are you okay?"

    "You are the fairy sister."

    "Huh?"

    "Are you calling me?"
